<thought>Based on the spectrum, a clear M and M+2 pair at m/z 211 and 213 shows an intensity ratio of roughly 3:1, which matches the characteristic isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). No other element shows a distinctive pattern (e.g., bromine would give ~1:1 M/M+2, sulfur would give a much smaller M+2). Therefore chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
